paid_market_gaps.gap: Czech public bodies want EDR/XDR, SIEM and 60-month MDR as one turnkey contract meeting Act 264/2025
Buyers struggle to get bids: Plzen hospital tender republished repeatedly with extended deadlines
On-premises XDR with supplied hardware required alongside SIEM and DLP, misfitting cloud-only vendors
Leading EDR vendors sell SIEM and MDR as separately quoted add-ons, not integrated priced bundles

wtp_evidence: Plzen University Hospital budgets CZK 76 million excl. VAT for 68 months of EDR/XDR+SIEM+MDR; Prague SSHMP tenders SIEM/XDR/DLP; EDR lists at $60-$185 per device/year.
bundling_note: Microsoft ingests Defender XDR alerts into Sentinel free and bundles Defender in M365 E5; Elastic now includes endpoint protection in SIEM pricing.
summary: Crowded vendor market, but real paid demand: Czech public bodies pay millions for compliant integrated EDR+SIEM+MDR. Opening is for local integrators/MSSPs packaging existing products for Act 264/2025 tenders, not a new product.
